name: merfish_production
description: MERFISH TREM2-R47H/5xFAD mouse brain (Johnston et al.; Brain Image Library ace-ear-nap): 432,794 cells x 300 genes, one model per animal (15; WT, 5xFAD, Trem2, Trem2;5xFAD), 6-NN graph within each half-section (19). Paper protocol, K = 12, five seeds, all genes (targeted panel), penalty grid widened to 50 values (top 1e-4 * 1.2^49 ~ 0.76) because the original benchmark selected the top of the 29-value grid in every MERFISH fit. Build data with scripts/data/prepare_merfish.py --download.
